guidebook.intro: Nyumya olufumo mu Lungereza: entandikwa, ebyaliwo n’enkomerero.

tips.title: Okutandika olufumo
body: Enfumo mu Lungereza zitandika ne **Once upon a time …** Abantu b’omu lufumo boogerwako ne **there was**: **There was a man. There was a woman and her child.**

tips.title: And then …
body: Mu Luganda **ne-** kigatta ebyaliwo: **n’agenda, n’alaba**. Mu Lungereza kozesa ebikolwa by’ebyayita ne **and** oba **then**: **Then he went into the forest. And he saw a lion!**

tips.title: Enkomerero
body: **In the end, he went back home.** Olufumo luggwa ne **The end.** oba **And that is the end of my story.**

culture.title: Enfumo ez’ekiro
body: Mu Buganda enfumo zinyumizibwa ekiro okumpi n’omuliro. Mu Lungereza abazadde basomera abaana **bedtime stories** nga tebannaba kwebaka.
